---
title: "Quality of life — primary imputation"
subtitle: "50 multilevel one-imputation MICE branches"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The primary QoL analysis uses exactly 50 one-imputation branches. Repeated
weekly rows are clustered by patient for multilevel PMM (`2l.pmm`), while
patient-level baseline fields use `2lonly.pmm`; the maximum is 50 iterations
and the donor pool is 5.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
if (!requireNamespace("miceadds", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'miceadds' is required for multilevel QoL imputation.")
library(miceadds)
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
if (length(indices) != 50L) stop("Primary QoL requires exactly 50 imputation branches.")
input_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "prepared.parquet")
branch_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "imputations"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: impute-qol
#| include: false
prepared <- module_read_parquet(input_path)
module_require_columns(
  prepared,
  c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "week", "q30", "baseline_q30"),
  "prepared QoL data"
)
prepared$.cluster <- as.integer(factor(prepared$id))
init <- mice::mice(prepared, m = 0, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
methods <- init$method
predictors <- init$predictorMatrix
methods[] <- ""
methods["q30"] <- "2l.pmm"
methods["baseline_q30"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
if ("ecog_fstcnt" %in% names(methods)) methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
if ("diagnosis" %in% names(methods)) methods["diagnosis"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
predictors[,] <- 0
predictors["q30", c("week", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "baseline_q30")] <- 1
predictors["q30", ".cluster"] <- -2
predictors["baseline_q30", c("tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt")] <- 1
predictors["baseline_q30", ".cluster"] <- -2
for (column in intersect(c("ecog_fstcnt", "diagnosis"), rownames(predictors))) {
  predictors[column, c("tx", "baseline_q30")] <- 1
  predictors[column, ".cluster"] <- -2
}
predictors[, c("id", ".cluster", "y", "baseline_state", "event_death", "survival_time_days", "death_week")] <- 0
predictors[c("id", ".cluster", "y", "baseline_state", "event_death", "survival_time_days", "death_week"), ] <- 0
validate_mice_spec(prepared, methods, predictors)

for (index in indices) {
  output_path <- file.path(branch_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-qol-imputation-%02d", index),
    input_paths = input_path,
    output_paths = output_path,
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "quality_of_life", imputation = index, m = 50L,
                   maxit = 50L, method = "multilevel PMM"),
    worker = function() {
      fitted <- mice::mice(
        data = prepared,
        method = methods,
        predictorMatrix = predictors,
        m = 1L,
        maxit = as.integer(config$imputation$main$maxit),
        donors = as.integer(config$imputation$main$donors),
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "imputation", index),
        printFlag = FALSE
      )
      completed <- mice::complete(fitted, action = 1L)
      completed$y <- q30_to_analysis_state(completed$q30, strict = TRUE)
      completed$baseline_state <- q30_to_analysis_state(completed$baseline_q30, strict = TRUE)
      completed <- completed[order(completed$id, completed$week), , drop = FALSE]
      completed$yprev <- ave(completed$y, completed$id, FUN = function(value) c(NA, head(value, -1L)))
      first_rows <- !duplicated(completed$id)
      completed$yprev[first_rows] <- completed$baseline_state[first_rows]
      completed$gap <- 1L
      completed <- completed[!is.na(completed$yprev), , drop = FALSE]
      completed$y <- factor(completed$y, levels = 1:7, ordered = TRUE)
      completed$yprev <- factor(completed$yprev, levels = 1:7, ordered = FALSE)
      completed$.cluster <- NULL
      module_save_parquet(completed, output_path)
    }
  )
}
branch_paths <- file.path(branch_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", indices))
if (length(branch_paths) != 50L || !all(file.exists(branch_paths))) {
  stop("QoL imputation stage did not produce all 50 required branches.")
}
```
